name: @voosh/cli
description: Node.js CLI for the voo.sh API.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsup src/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --dts --sourcemap --no-splitting --external commander
scripts.test: yarn build && vitest run tests/cli.test.ts tests/cli.integration.test.ts
